part.text:
Verified: Release r42 (10:00) introduced smaller cache + retry policy. Errors rose 120->810, cache hits fell 92%->51%, retries 110->2200 at 10:03. Dependency CPU hit 96%. Rollback (10:06) restored metrics (140 errors, 90% cache, 170 retries).

Hypothesis (Finding-1): Cache thrashing (92%→51%) caused cache misses, triggering retries (110→2200) that saturated dependency CPU (96%).

Synthesis: r42’s reduced cache + aggressive retry policy caused cascading failure. Cache misses spiked retries, which overloaded the dependency. Rollback reversed this.

Validation test: At 10:03, replay a controlled request burst with r42 settings. Measure: cache hit rate, retry count, and dependency CPU. If cache hit rate drops below 70% and retry count exceeds 10x baseline while dependency CPU > 90%, the hypothesis is confirmed.
